problems: The door's arched top is a cylinder whose front face lies in the same plane as the door box. The lower half z-fights and renders as a black half-disc, so the door reads as a face with a grinning mouth. Set the arch cylinder back so the box covers its lower half.
The arch rises above the rectangular door frame, so the frame stops partway up the door. Give the frame a matching arched top.
The door is too tall: its arch touches the sill of the upstairs window above it. Lower the door so it sits clearly on the ground floor.

The roof reads pale grey, not dark. The big front slope catches the key light and reflects the sky through the satin finish, so it is one of the lightest parts of the card. The brief asks for a dark roof. Fix: make the roof material darker and matte.
The walls are a very pale lavender and nearly white where the light hits them. They should read as grey-purple. Fix: darken the wall colour so it holds against the bright sky and grass.

The house reads as a cosy cottage, not a crooked haunted mansion, because the lean is too faint. Fix: make the lean stronger and tip the tower's roof a little the other way. Everything still stays attached.
